meta.name: Guild of Gaming - Board Game Inventory

games.title: Pandemic
games.description: Save the world from deadly diseases using teamwork and specialist roles.

games.title: Forbidden Island
games.description: Grab treasures from a sinking island before time runs out.
games.notes: Forbidden Desert is the sequel; both are in the collection.

games.title: Forbidden Desert
games.description: Rebuild a flying machine in the desert before time runs out.
games.notes: Sequel to Forbidden Island; both are in the collection.

games.title: Castle Panic
games.description: Work as a team to protect your castle from attacking monsters.

games.title: Legends of Andor
games.description: Narrative co-op fantasy with tactical quests and monster fighting.

games.title: Marvel Zombies: A Zombicide Game
games.description: Control zombified Marvel heroes on a chaos-fueled mission of hunger and mayhem.

games.title: The Walking Dead: No Sanctuary
games.description: Survive the zombie apocalypse in a gritty, story-driven co-op with group morale management.

games.title: Dungeon Saga
games.description: Classic dungeon crawl with heroes vs undead, campaign or one-shot play.

games.title: Planet of the Apes
games.description: Each player controls part of Taylor's psyche from the original film. Cooperate to survive!

games.title: Dead of Winter
games.description: Psychological survival game with secret goals... and possible betrayal.

games.title: Super Dungeon Explore
games.description: Anime-style dungeon crawler. Heroes vs evil overlord in a loot-fueled rampage.
games.notes: Source lists player count as 2+ with no upper limit.

games.title: Wingspan
games.description: Attract beautiful birds and build powerful chains in this peaceful, strategic engine builder.

expansions.title: Wingspan: Asia
expansions.note: Standalone 1–2 player game with a 2-player Duet Mode, or expands the base game to 6–7 players with Flock Mode.

games.title: Ticket to Ride: Europe
games.description: Build the most efficient train routes across Europe.

games.title: Catan
games.description: Trade and build settlements to dominate the island. The classic gateway game.

games.title: The Quacks of Quedlinburg
games.description: Brew potions in this fun push-your-luck bag builder. Don't blow up your cauldron!

games.title: 7 Wonders
games.description: Develop your civilisation through three ages of card drafting and wonder building.

games.title: Carcassonne
games.description: Create the medieval landscape together, then compete for control!

games.title: Tsuro of the Seas
games.description: Stay on the board while dodging sea monsters and path chaos!

games.title: Hues and Cues
games.description: Guess colours from vague clues. A chill, creative game that'll surprise you.

games.title: Dixit
games.description: Use beautiful surreal art to bluff, guess, and interpret creative clues.

games.title: Block Party
games.description: Build wild things from blocks based on mystery themes. Great for all ages.

games.title: The Resistance
games.description: Uncover the spies in your team before they sabotage the mission.

games.title: Saboteur
games.description: Who's digging for gold and who's secretly ruining the tunnels?

games.title: Mascarade
games.description: Swap identities, bluff your way to coins, and try to keep track of who's who.

games.title: Shadow Hunters
games.description: Find your faction and take out the opposition in this fast-paced deduction brawl.
